note: Site-specific reflection scaffolds, unlocked by completing the stillness quest (SAKSHI-COMPLETE §13.6). Each follows the four-truths inquiry from 06-DHAMMA-ENGINE §8: name the dukkha, name its origin, is cessation conceivable, one step. It ASKS, never advises. Distress detection halts the flow and surfaces verified Nepali helplines: the reflection must not ship until that override is tested and live. ne strings await a native-speaker pass.

opening.en: You are sitting where a life is said to have begun. Beginnings are also endings of something else.
opening.ne: यहाँ एउटा जीवन सुरु भएको मानिन्छ। सुरुवात कुनै अर्को कुराको अन्त्य पनि हो।

stages.en: What are you carrying today that feels heavy?
stages.ne: आज तपाईंले बोकिरहनुभएको कुनचाहिँ कुरा गह्रौं लाग्छ?

stages.en: Where does that heaviness seem to come from?
stages.ne: त्यो गह्रौंपन कहाँबाट आएको जस्तो लाग्छ?

stages.en: Can you picture setting even a little of it down?
stages.ne: त्यसको अलिकति भए पनि बिसाएको कल्पना गर्न सक्नुहुन्छ?

stages.en: What is one small thing you could do next?
stages.ne: अब तपाईंले गर्न सक्ने एउटा सानो कुरा के हो?

opening.en: This is a place people travel across the world to stand in for a moment.
opening.ne: यो यस्तो स्थान हो जहाँ एक क्षण उभिन मानिसहरू संसारभरिबाट यात्रा गर्छन्।

stages.en: What made you want to come and see for yourself?
stages.ne: आफैं आएर हेर्ने इच्छा तपाईंलाई किन जाग्यो?

stages.en: What were you hoping to find here?
stages.ne: यहाँ के भेट्न आशा गर्नुभएको थियो?

stages.en: Is the thing you were looking for something a place can give?
stages.ne: तपाईंले खोजेको कुरा कुनै स्थानले दिन सक्ने खालको हो?

stages.en: What will you take with you when you leave?
stages.ne: जाँदा तपाईं आफूसँग के लैजानुहुनेछ?

opening.en: An emperor who once waged war stood here and left a mark meant to outlast him. It has.
opening.ne: कुनै बेला युद्ध लडेका सम्राट यहाँ उभिए र आफूभन्दा बढी टिक्ने चिन्ह छाडे। त्यो टिक्यो।

stages.en: What would you want to be remembered for?
stages.ne: तपाईं केका लागि सम्झना गरिन चाहनुहुन्छ?

stages.en: What are you spending your days on instead?
stages.ne: त्यसको सट्टा तपाईं आफ्ना दिनहरू केमा बिताइरहनुभएको छ?

stages.en: Could those two things move closer together?
stages.ne: ती दुई कुरा एकअर्कानजिक ल्याउन सकिन्छ?

stages.en: What is one change within reach this week?
stages.ne: यस हप्ता पुग्न सकिने एउटा परिवर्तन के हो?

opening.en: It took a century of careful looking to fix this one spot with certainty.
opening.ne: यो एउटा स्थान निश्चितताका साथ पहिचान गर्न एक शताब्दीको सूक्ष्म अवलोकन लाग्यो।

stages.en: What is one thing you believe without having checked it?
stages.ne: तपाईंले जाँच नगरी विश्वास गर्नुभएको एउटा कुरा के हो?

stages.en: What keeps you from going and looking?
stages.ne: गएर हेर्नबाट तपाईंलाई केले रोक्छ?

stages.en: What would change if you saw it for yourself?
stages.ne: आफ्नै आँखाले देख्नुभयो भने के फरक पर्थ्यो?

stages.en: What is one thing you could check this week?
stages.ne: यस हप्ता तपाईंले जाँच्न सक्ने एउटा कुरा के हो?

opening.en: Stupas recorded here in 1957 were gone by a later visit. Everything built is on its way to being ruins.
opening.ne: सन् १९५७ मा यहाँ अभिलेख गरिएका स्तूप पछिको भ्रमणसम्म हराइसकेका थिए। बनेको हरेक कुरा भग्नावशेष बन्ने बाटोमा छ।

stages.en: What are you holding onto as if it will last?
stages.ne: टिकिरहन्छ भन्ने ठानेर तपाईं केमा अल्झिरहनुभएको छ?

stages.en: What is it costing you to hold on?
stages.ne: अल्झिरहँदा तपाईंलाई के मूल्य चुकाउनु परिरहेको छ?

stages.en: What might loosening the grip feel like?
stages.ne: पकड खुकुलो पार्दा कस्तो अनुभव होला?

stages.en: What is one thing you can hold more lightly?
stages.ne: तपाईंले अझ हलुका गरी समात्न सक्ने एउटा कुरा के हो?

opening.en: This is the town Siddhartha grew up in and chose to leave. The place asks a quiet question.
opening.ne: यो त्यो नगर हो जहाँ सिद्धार्थ हुर्के र छाड्ने रोजाइ गरे। यो स्थलले एउटा मौन प्रश्न सोध्छ।

stages.en: What are you holding on to?
stages.ne: तपाईं केमा अल्झिनुभएको छ?

stages.en: Why does it feel hard to let it go?
stages.ne: त्यो छाड्न किन गाह्रो लाग्छ?

stages.en: What would be left if you did?
stages.ne: छाड्नुभयो भने के बाँकी रहन्छ?

stages.en: What is one step you could take toward that?
stages.ne: त्यसतर्फ तपाईंले चाल्न सक्ने एउटा पाइला के हो?
